newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATN plans buy out of health care firm.
newsitem.headline: ATN plans buy out of health care firm.

text.p: ATN Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it was negotiating to buy out a firm engaged in the health care business.

"Negotiations are currently onstream for the entry of ATN Holdings into the health care industry through the acquisition of the majority of the outstanding capital stock of Mediserv Inc, along with its various medical subsidiaries," vice president Andrew Cocuac said in a statement.
Shares of ATN A closed up by 0.25 centavos at 7.75 centavos at the Philippine Stock Exchange on Wednesday while its B shares jumped 1.25 centavos to nine centavos.
